The separate machine-learning program investigates predictive scores for human review prioritization. Predictive-score integration into the Portal is proposed and requires evaluation, review, and operational approval before use in reviewer workflows.

documents.title: Developing machine-learning models for audit prioritization

passages.text: I implemented a supervised-learning program in Python and PySpark to investigate audit prioritization. The work connects bill-level features with candidate models, repeatable evaluation, probability calibration, and scoring outputs. The program remains experimental. Saved notebooks document implemented code paths and configurations; execution records are needed to substantiate completed evaluations, model selection, and operational readiness.
passages.keywords: machine learning ml experiment implemented pipeline evaluation performance accuracy production deployed

passages.text: Random Forest is configured for continued experimentation, including the fixed fallback path. Comparative model results require execution records and runtime package verification.
passages.keywords: random forest best model ranking results measured accuracy performance evaluation

passages.text: The historical Random Audit program supplied reviewed bills from which to construct labeled training examples. The implemented target is whether the review's reduction field is populated: a recorded zero counts as positive, while a null or blank field counts as negative within that reviewed sample. This predicts a recording convention associated with bill review, rather than the amount reduced or selection into the random program. It is not a label for fraud, proof of improper billing, or a direct instruction to initiate a full audit.
passages.keywords: fraud labels target reduction audit prioritization

passages.text: The modeling engine is Spark ML, using Python/PySpark in Azure Synapse. Spark pipelines combine categorical indexing, model-appropriate encoding, median imputation, and vector assembly with the estimator. Learned preprocessing is fitted within each training fold. pandas supports fold-metric summaries around the Spark training workflow.
passages.keywords: spark synapse python pyspark pandas framework machine learning

passages.text: Calibration and backtesting. I implemented Platt calibration using Spark logistic regression on the raw model probability, with a separate calibration window, a later test window, a buffer for delayed labels, and rolling time-based backtests. The separate windows distinguish model fitting, probability calibration, and assessment on later data. Calibration can change probability interpretation without necessarily improving ranking.
passages.keywords: calibration backtest platt probability chronological evaluation

passages.text: The study uses a vector space model and kernel ridge regression, evaluated with randomized ten-fold cross-validation, to examine the relationship between ranch characteristics and profitability. These methods connect a business forecasting question with statistical learning. The publisher’s paper provides the full methodology and acknowledgment.
passages.keywords: research method kernel ridge regression validation cattle ranch profitability
